A note on timing. Sixteen days out is comfortable — if the basket goes in this week. Every dress below was stock-checked in a UK 10 on 10 June 2026, with live prices and a button straight to it. The plan at the bottom makes the fortnight easy: order a shortlist now, try everything on at home over the weekend, send back the rest.
The line-up · 28 gowns

Ranked picks

Twenty-eight gowns made the book, from a few hundred screened. Every one was checked in stock on the day, photographed honestly, and chosen because the bodice has proper engineering and the skirt moves — built to be danced in until the survivors’ photo. The top of the list answers the brief most exactly; further down sit the wildcards, the rentals (badged), and — right at the end — two beauties worth a free restock alert. Honestly, though: there is no wrong answer on this page.

White tie, decoded

Field notes

  • Floor-length is the rule. Every pick here is full-length or ankle-grazing — both read perfectly at a white-tie ball, and the ankle lengths clear the dance floor (and the Trinity lawns) beautifully.
  • It’s a twelve-hour event. Fold-up flats in the bag, pashmina stashed for the 4am drift along the river. The survivors’ photo waits for no one.
  • Bodice engineering wins the night. A boned or elasticated bodice, a properly fitted longline strapless bra and a strip of dress tape: that bardot neckline will not budge between the first waltz and the last DJ.
  • Silver with sapphire. Cool-toned stones and silver settings sing against every jewel shade on this page — keep the metals cool, and carry the sparkle up to the ears.
The fortnight

Week plan

Tonight Order the shortlist — two or three favourites, one basket. Returns are free nearly everywhere, so let them compete on the bedroom mirror, not in theory.
In parallel Place the rental holds. Book the hire window to cover 25–28 June so travel days are covered, and ring any try-on appointments now — ball week is rush week.
13–14 June The try-on. Good light, the right bra, the actual shoes. Crown the winner; start the returns the same day.
By 16 June Alterations buffer. If the hem or bodice needs a tweak, book it now — a good tailor turns a hem around in under a week, comfortably before the ball.
26 June Dance.
The last 5%

Finishing kit
